description: The role-flow gate and composition of first-layer and role multipliers.

mutants.description: Force the gated first-layer, internal-solid, and gap-fill multipliers to run even when set_other_flow_ratios is false, while retaining the production read to avoid an unused-field build warning.

Replace the first-layer composition with the bare ratio while retaining a typed read. This drops the path's existing volume/role composition instead of duplicating the existing ignore-first-layer mutant, so the compound role products are observably wrong.
